<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: center"><B><FONT size=2 face=Arial>Report of Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm</FONT></B></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>To the Board of Trustees of Vanguard Index Funds and Shareholders of Vanguard Small-Cap Index Fund, Vanguard Small-Cap Growth Index Fund and Vanguard Small-Cap Value Index Fund</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><B><I><FONT size=2 face=Arial>Opinions on the Financial Statements</FONT></I></B></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>We have audited the accompanying statements of net assets</FONT><FONT size=2 face=Arial>&#8212;</FONT><FONT size=2 face=Arial>investments summary of Vanguard Small-Cap Index Fund, Vanguard Small-Cap Growth Index Fund and Vanguard Small-Cap Value Index Fund (three of the funds constituting Vanguard Index Funds, hereafter collectively referred to as the "Funds") as of December 31, 2017, the related statements of operations for the year ended December 31, 2017, the statements of changes in net assets for each of the two years in the period ended December 31, 2017, including the related notes, and the financial highlights for each of the five years in the period ended December 31, 2017 (included in Item 1 of this Form N-CSR) and the schedules of investments (included in Item 6 of this Form N-CSR) as of December 31, 2017 </FONT><FONT size=2 face=Arial>(collectively referred to as the &#8220;financial statements&#8221;). In our opinion, the financial statements present fairly, in all material respects, the financial </FONT><FONT size=2 face=Arial>position of each of the Funds as of December 31, 2017, the results of each of their operations for the year then ended, the changes in each of their net assets for each of the two years in the period ended December 31, 2017 and each of the financial highlights for each of the five years in the period ended December 31, 2017 in conformity with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America.</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><B><I><FONT size=2 face=Arial>Basis for Opinions</FONT></I></B></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>These financial statements are the responsibility of the Funds&#8217; management. Our responsibility is to express an opinion on the Funds&#8217; financ</FONT><FONT size=2 face=Arial>ial statements based on our audits. We are a public accounting </FONT><FONT size=2 face=Arial>firm registered with the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (United States) (&#8220;PCAOB&#8221;) and are </FONT><FONT size=2 face=Arial>required to be independent with respect to the Funds in accordance with the U.S. federal securities laws and the applicable rules and regulations of the Securities and Exchange Commission and the PCAOB.</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>We conducted our audits of these financial statements in accordance with the standards of the PCAOB. Those standards require that we plan and perform the audit to obtain reasonable assurance about whether the financial statements are free of material misstatement, whether due to error or fraud.</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>Our audits included performing procedures to assess the risks of material misstatement of the financial statements, whether due to error or fraud, and performing procedures that respond to those risks. Such procedures included examining, on a test basis, evidence regarding the amounts and disclosures in the financial statements. Our audits also included evaluating the accounting principles used and significant estimates made by management, as well as evaluating the overall presentation of the financial statements. Our procedures </FONT><FONT color=#222222 size=2 face=Arial>included </FONT><FONT size=2 face=Arial>confirmation of securities owned as of December 31, 2017 by correspondence with the custodians and brokers and by agreement to the underlying ownership records of the transfer agent; when replies were not received from brokers</FONT><FONT color=#222222 size=2 face=Arial>, we performed other auditing procedures. </FONT><FONT size=2 face=Arial>We believe that our audits provide a reasonable basis for our opinions.</FONT></P>
<IMG border=0 src="smallcapindex_pwcltrx1x2.jpg"> <BR>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>February 15, 2018</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>We have served as the auditor of one or more investment companies in The Vanguard Group of Funds</FONT><BR><FONT size=2 face=Arial>since 1975.</FONT></P>

<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">We have audited the accompanying statement of net assets</FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">&#151;</FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">investments summary of Vanguard Extended Market Index Fund (one of the funds constituting Vanguard Index Funds, referred to hereafter as the "Fund") as of December 31, 2017, the related statement of operations for the year ended December 31, 2017, the statement of changes in net assets for each of the two years in the period ended December 31, 2017, including the related notes, and the financial highlights for each of the periods indicated therein (included in Item 1 of this Form N-CSR) and the schedule of investments (included in Item 6 of this Form N-</FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">CSR) as of December 31, 2017 (collectively referred to as the &#147;financial statements&#148;). In our opinion, the financial statements p</FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">resent fairly, in all material respects, the financial position of the Fund as of December 31, 2017, the results of its operations for the year then ended, the changes in its net assets for each of the two years in the period ended December 31, 2017 and the financial highlights for each of the periods indicated therein in conformity with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<B><I><FONT size=2 face="Arial">Basis for Opinion</FONT></I></B></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">

Those standards require that we plan and perform the audit to obtain reasonable assurance about whether the financial statements are free of material misstatement, whether due to error or fraud.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">Our audits included performing procedures to assess the risks of material misstatement of the financial statements, whether due to error or fraud, and performing procedures that respond to those risks. <A name="page_1"></A><BR>

<a name="_bclPageBorder1"></a><DIV STYLE="PADDING-RIGHT: 0%; PADDING-LEFT: 0%">
<P style="text-align: center;">
<B><FONT size=2 face="Arial">THE VANGUARD FUNDS&#146;</FONT></B><BR>
<B><FONT size=2 face="Arial">CODE OF ETHICS</FONT></B><BR>
<B><FONT size=2 face="Arial">FOR</FONT></B><BR>
<B><FONT size=2 face="Arial">SENIOR EXECUTIVE AND FINANCIAL OFFICERS</FONT></B></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<B><FONT size=2 face="Arial">I. Introduction</FONT></B></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="Arial">The Board of Trustees (the &#147;Fund Board&#148;) of each registered investment company that </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">is managed, sponsored, and distributed by The Vanguard Group, Inc. (&#147;VGI&#148;) or its subsidiaries (each, a &#147;Vanguard Fund&#148; and collectively, the &#147;Vanguard Funds&#148;) has adopted this code of ethics (the &#147;Code&#148;) as required by Section 406 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act. The Code applies to </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">the individuals in positions listed on Exhibit A (the &#147;Covered Officers&#148;). All Covered Officers, along with employees of VGI, are subject to separate and distinct obligations from this Code </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">under a Code of Ethics adopted pursuant to Rule 17j-1 under the Investment Company Act of 1940 (&#147;17j-1 Code of Ethics&#148;), policies to prevent the misuse of non-public information, and </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">other internal compliance guidelines and policies that may be in effect from time to time.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">This Code is designed to promote:</FONT></P>
<UL>
<LI>
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">Honest and ethical conduct, including the ethical handling of conflicts of interest;</FONT></LI>
<LI>
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">Full, fair, accurate, timely, and understandable disclosure in reports and documents that</FONT> <FONT size=2 face="Arial">a Vanguard Fund files with, or submits to, the U.S. Securities and Exchange</FONT> <FONT size=2 face="Arial">Commission (&#147;SEC&#148;), and in other public communications made by the Vanguard</FONT> <FONT size=2 face="Arial">Funds or VGI;</FONT></LI>
<LI>
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">Compliance with applicable laws, governmental rules, and regulations;</FONT></LI>
<LI>
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">Prompt internal reporting to those identified in the Code of violations of the Code; and</FONT></LI>
<LI>
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">Accountability for adherence to the Code.</FONT></LI>
</UL>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<B><FONT size=2 face="Arial">II. Actual or Apparent Conflicts of Interest</FONT></B></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">A. Covered Officers should conduct all activities in accordance with the following </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">principles:</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">1. Clients&#146; interests come first. In the course of fulfilling their duties and responsibilities to VGI clients, Covered Officers must at all times place the interests of VGI clients first. In particular, Covered Officers must avoid serving their own personal interests ahead of the interests of VGI clients.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">2. Conflicts of interest must be avoided. Covered Officers must avoid any situation involving an actual or potential conflict of interest or possible impropriety with respect to their duties and responsibilities to VGI clients. Covered Officers must disclose and report at least annually any situation that may present the potential for a conflict of interest to Vanguard&#146;s Compliance Department, consistent with the 17j-1 Code of Ethics.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=1 face="Arial">1</FONT></P>
</DIV>

<HR noshade align="center" width="100%" size=2><DIV STYLE="page-break-before: always">&nbsp;</div>



<!--$$/page=-->
<A name="page_2"></A><BR>

<a name="_bclPageBorder2"></a><DIV STYLE="PADDING-RIGHT: 0%; PADDING-LEFT: 0%">
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">3. Compromising situations must be avoided. Covered Officers must not take advantage of their position of trust and responsibility. Covered Officers must avoid any situation that might compromise or call into question their exercise of full independent judgment in the best interests of VGI clients.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">All activities of Covered Officers should be guided by and adhere to these fiduciary standards </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">regardless of whether the activity is specifically described in this Code.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">B. Restricted Activities include the following:</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">1. Prohibition on secondary employment. Covered Officers are prohibited from </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">accepting or serving in any form of secondary employment. Secondary employment </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">that does not create a potential conflict of interest may be approved by the General Counsel of VGI.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">2. Prohibition on service as director or public official. Unless approved by the General Counsel of VGI, Covered Officers are prohibited from serving on the board of </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">directors of any publicly traded company or in an official capacity for any federal, state, or local government (or governmental agency or instrumentality).</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">3. Prohibition on misuse of Vanguard time or property. Covered Officers are prohibited from making use of time, equipment, services, personnel or property of any Vanguard entity for any purposes other than the performance of their duties and </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">responsibilities in connection with the Vanguard Funds or other Vanguard-related </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">entities.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<B><FONT size=2 face="Arial">III. </FONT></B><B><FONT size=2 face="Arial">Disclosure and Compliance</FONT></B></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">A. Each Covered Officer should be familiar with the disclosure requirements generally </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">applicable to the Vanguard Funds.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">B. Each Covered Officer should not knowingly misrepresent, or cause others to </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">misrepresent, facts about the Vanguard Funds to others, including to the Vanguard </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">Funds&#146; directors and auditors, or to government regulators and self-regulatory organizations.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">C. Each Covered Officer should, to the extent appropriate within the Covered Officer&#146;s area of responsibility, consult with other officers and employees of VGI and advisors to a Vanguard Fund with the goal of promoting full, fair, accurate, timely and understandable disclosure in the reports and documents the Vanguard Fund files with, or submits to, the SEC and in other public communications made by a Vanguard Fund.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">D. It is the responsibility of each Covered Officer to promote compliance with the standards and restrictions imposed by applicable laws, rules, regulations, and the 17j-1 Code of Ethics.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<B><FONT size=2 face="Arial">IV. Reporting and Accountability</FONT></B></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">A. Each Covered Officer must:</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: center;">
<FONT size=1 face="Arial">2</FONT></P>
</DIV>

<HR noshade align="center" width="100%" size=2><DIV STYLE="page-break-before: always">&nbsp;</div>



<!--$$/page=-->
<A name="page_3"></A><BR>

<a name="_bclPageBorder3"></a><DIV STYLE="PADDING-RIGHT: 0%; PADDING-LEFT: 0%">
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">1. </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">Upon adoption or amendment of the Code (or thereafter as applicable, upon becoming a Covered Officer), affirm in writing that he or she has received, read, and </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">understands the Code;</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">2. </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">Affirm at least annually in writing that he or she has complied with the requirements </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">of the Code;</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">3. </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">Not retaliate against any other Covered Officer or any employee of VGI for reports </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">of potential violations of the Code that are made in good faith; and</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">4. </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">Notify the General Counsel of VGI promptly if the Covered Officer knows of any </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">violations of this Code.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">B. The Vanguard Funds will use the following procedures in investigating and enforc</FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">ing </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">this Code:</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">1. </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">The General Counsel of VGI is responsible for applying this Code to specific </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">situations and has the authority to interpret this Code in any particular situation. The </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">General Counsel will report on an as-needed basis to the Fund Board regarding </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">activities subject to the Code.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">2. </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">The General Counsel will take all appropriate action to investigate any potential </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">violations of the Code that are reported to him or her.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">3. </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">If, after investigation, the General Counsel believes that no material violation of the </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">Code has occurred, the General Counsel is not required to take any further action.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">4. </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">Any matter that the General Counsel believes is a material violation of the Code will </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">be reported to the Chief Compliance Officer and the Fund Board.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">5. </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">If the Fund Board concurs that a material violation of the Code has occurred, the </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">Fund Board will consider appropriate action. Appropriate action may include reassignment, suspension, or dismissal of the applicable Covered Officer(s), or any </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">other sanctions the Fund Board deems appropriate. Appropriate action may also include review of, and appropriate modifications to, applicable policies and procedures.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">6. </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">Any changes to or waiver of this Code will, to the extent required, be disclosed as provided by SEC rules.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: center;">
<FONT size=1 face="Arial">3</FONT></P>
</DIV>

<HR noshade align="center" width="100%" size=2><DIV STYLE="page-break-before: always">&nbsp;</div>



<!--$$/page=-->
<A name="page_4"></A><BR>

<a name="_bclPageBorder4"></a><DIV STYLE="PADDING-RIGHT: 0%; PADDING-LEFT: 0%">
<P style="text-align: left;">
<B><FONT size=2 face="Arial">Other Policies and Procedures</FONT></B></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="Arial">This Code shall be the sole code of conduct adopted by the Vanguard Funds for purposes of Section 406 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act and the rules and forms applicable to </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">registered investment companies thereunder. Insofar as other policies or procedures of the Vanguard Funds, VGI, or other service providers govern or purport to govern the behavior or </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">activities of the Covered Officers, they are superseded by this Code to the extent that they </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">overlap or conflict with the provisions of this Code.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="Arial">VGI&#146;s and the Vanguard Funds&#146; 17j-1 Code of Ethics, policies to prevent the misuse of non-public information, and other internal compliance guidelines and policies that may be in effect from time to time are separate requirements applying to the Covered Officers and others, and are not part of this Code.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<B><FONT size=2 face="Arial">VI. Amendments</FONT></B></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="Arial">This Code may not be materially amended except by the approval of a majority vote of </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">the independent trustees of the Fund Board. Non-material, technical, and administrative </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">revisions of the Code do not have to be approved by the Fund Board. Amendments must be in writing and communicated promptly to the Covered Officers, who shall affirm receipt of the </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">amended Code in accordance with Section IV. A. 1.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<B><FONT size=2 face="Arial">VII. Confidentiality</FONT></B></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="Arial">All reports and records prepared or maintained pursuant to this Code shall be considered </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">confidential and shall be maintained and protected accordingly. Except as otherwise required </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">by law or this Code, such matters shall not be disclosed to anyone other than the Fund Board, </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">VGI&#146;s General Counsel and the Chief Compliance Officer of VGI and the Vanguard Funds.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">Last Reviewed: July </FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">21</FONT><FONT size=2 face="Arial">, 2017</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: center;">
<FONT size=1 face="Arial">4</FONT></P>
